scope: Read-only code and recorded-results review; no GPU execution or heavy test execution; this JSON is the only written artifact.
status: no remaining correctness blockers found; publication dataset and pre-execution manifest verified
verified_invariants: GPU kernel compares every valid output word as uint, groups cover4096markers each, final partial block is bounded by3*N; no hashing, approximate floating-point comparison, or sampling.
All256threads reach reduction barriers; one group uniquely owns each flags entry and snapshot block. Copy occurs only for changed blocks and covers every word in each such block.
CPU certificate owns copies of reference, layers and edges. Context reset invalidates summaries; first check performs full CPU validation regardless of flags.

Cached CPU pointwise arithmetic matches historical finite checks, FP64 differences, strict error>5e-4, std::hypot normalization and inclusive band bounds. Count sums and max reductions preserve all historical fields.
Failed numerical summaries remain valid cache entries representing failure; repaired blocks replace previous counters/maxima.
GPU command completion precedes CPU reads of owned snapshot/flags; harness also waits for placement completion before invoking separate validator queue.
API exception path invalidates all CPU certificates. Output count mismatch rejects and invalidates. Serialization prevents snapshot changes during CPU checking.

100M benchmark records context setup and first certification separately; repeated validation timers include comparison/copy, GPU completion, CPU rechecks and reduction; independent serial audits are excluded explicitly.
Sparse mode reports explicit checked markers/coordinates, coverage and covers_all_markers; its check.expected/actual are whole-buffer size checks, not sampled coverage.
Final wrapper rejects absent command/encoder/flags and nonpositive/nonfinite GPU duration; all exceptions invalidate certificates. Producer completion precondition is explicit.
Runtime --run full-gpu validates every iteration using exact cache coverage, without an extra serial audit after each iteration. Initial certification and final full serial audit are explicit.
Runtime sparse-rotating regenerates the plan with the iteration index and includes planning in the repeated validation and combined clocks. Fixed sparse mode reports plan reuse.
Final benchmark output labels sparse full fallback by effective_validation_mode, checked coverage, and exact serial-summary equality when covers_all_markers is true.

Final boundedUnsigned helper requires a nonempty decimal digit string, parses unsigned long long, checks positive allowed bounds before narrowing, and rejects overflow through the existing exception path.
limitations: All-word GPU comparison is an exact certificate reuse method, not fresh GPU FP64 arithmetic. It favors repeated or partly unchanged output.
Every-block-changed mode is slower than full CPU checking in this measured run; report both and initial certification.
Caller must ensure output producer completion and exclusive access before/during validation; validator separate queue cannot infer other-queue dependencies.
Original controls do not inject a nil encoder or command-creation failure; failure-path fix is based on source review.
No M4 performance claim is supported by these Aureon/M5Max results.

Publication benchmark and audit-free repeated-runtime timings have different validation/audit cadence; present each separately rather than attributing their difference to an additional implementation change.

resolved_findings.issue: validate does not reject a nil compute command encoder. A valid command buffer can then encode no comparison, complete, and reuse old flags/snapshot.
resolved_findings.required_fix: Reject nil command buffer and compute encoder before encoding; check flags buffer readiness too. Catch path already invalidates CPU certificates.
resolved_findings.status: resolved in final source; explicit command/encoder and flags readiness checks observed
